items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: one of the greatest drummers I’ve played with recently is Lewis Nash

ctx.x: I know, there’s so many people.
You’re really putting me on the spot there because I could do about a half a dozen. Actually one of the greatest drummers I’ve played with recently is Lewis Nash, I love © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
playing with him. And I don’t know, Michael Moore is still my favorite bass player period. There’s a lot of other great bass players too.
